notes: CDF cohort: request admission in [2000,4000) ms, retained until eventual completion even after 4000 ms. All source runs fully completed; no right censoring.
x=(completion-admission)/(8*manifest per_layer_us/1000); own_compute_ms independently agrees. This excludes arrival-to-admission waiting and is a prefill proxy, not observed first-token latency.
SLO passes when elapsed <=1.5*ideal+1e-9 ms. Plot copies alone normalize ratios within1e-9 ms of1 or1.5; raw ratios preserved.
Each seed ECDF receives1/3 weight; macro SLO is the arithmetic mean of the3seed percentages. Not pooled request counts.
Macro mean maximum is the mean of3within-seed maxima; max across all seeds is separately reported. Full CDF must preserve the latter long tail.
Identical whole inputs do not imply identical warm admitted cohorts: policy progress changes which requests are admitted inside the time window.
Regime labels refer to input groups and the warm window. semi was previously called locally underloaded: each strategy alternates between all-disks-under-capacity and at-least-one-disk-over-capacity.
Demand is current admitted request per-disk V/C, including its compute and stalls, without double-counting next-request L0 prefetch. Classification is per-disk, not total>120 GiB/s.
The three regime inputs have different profile mixtures; this is a strategy comparison within each group, not an isolated causal experiment varying only offered load.

All27source commands record the same core source hash map. Study-specific runner and metric extension hashes differ; this audit rederived all CDF and load statistics from common raw request+manifest fields.
